_how_to_enable_a_real_bank: 1. Put the test certificates under certs/<id>/ (gitignored): client.crt/key (mTLS), ca.crt, signing.key + signing.crt (JWS seal).
2. export OB_<ID>_ACCESS_TOKEN=... and OB_<ID>_CONSENT_ID=... after completing the bank's OAuth/SCA flow once by hand (optional: OB_<ID>_EXPIRED_CONSENT_ID).
3. set enabled:true. Anything that cannot run is reported as NOT RUN / not_assessed with the reason - never as a pass.

4. Request sealing (Georgian JWS profile 0.5.RC1) and response seal verification are implemented in src/shared/jws.js; the TLS/mTLS probe is in src/auditor/tls.js. All of it is tested against simulators only, not against a real bank.
